ns2:course.label: Floral Crop Quality Evaluation
ns2:course.description: Teaches students industry standards for acceptable potted flowers, potted foliage, and cut flower crops. Students activiely participate in staging plant classes for judging, judge plant material, and justify class placement. The top four students are invited to represent the University of Illinois in the National Intercollegiate Floral Quality Evaluation and Design Competition. May be repeated to a maximum of 2 hours if topics vary.
